nodes.label: Automatic minimum allocation
nodes.rationale: After assignment, reserve subscriber floors capped by maxima and proportionally reduce remaining minimum headroom within every ancestor budget. Preserve maxima, identity, IP and parent. Floors that cannot fit block publication.

nodes.label: DHCP per-server speed policy
nodes.rationale: Auto resolves server comment, server-name suffix, manual fallback; explicit modes read only selected source. Malformed/unlimited/zero rules remain unresolved. Keys use exact router ID and actual server; lease comments no longer define speeds.

nodes.label: Legacy speed compatibility boundary
nodes.rationale: PPP comment precedence follows updatecsv.py; router rate direction and bare units differ, DHCP uses server policy, Hotspot uses mapped profile instead of local defaults. Old config.json is not imported.

nodes.label: Requested speed preview
nodes.rationale: Shows requested router/policy minimums before WAN allocation; immutable inventories and stale-result guards protect the preview; saved inventory does not prove effective live RADIUS/session policy.

nodes.label: Router receive/transmit conversion
nodes.rationale: Router receive is subscriber upload and transmit is subscriber download; bare values are bits per second and decimal units apply. Comment/manual speeds keep subscriber download/upload order.

nodes.label: Subscriber speed resolution
nodes.rationale: PPP: secret comment, active comment, profile comment, profile rate, profile-name suffix. Hotspot: local user comment, profile comment, profile rate. Invalid explicit rates never fall through to names; unresolved plans receive no guessed maximum.

nodes.label: Indexed exact active-server joins

nodes.label: Subscriber rates and topology capacity separation
nodes.norm_label: subscriber rates and topology capacity separation
nodes.rationale: Manual rates are subscriber download/upload Mbps; they must not change topology capacities.

nodes.label: No DHCP lease speed fallback
nodes.rationale: This later historical plan replaces the older lease-source behavior; bound leases inherit their actual active DHCP server speed.

nodes.label: DHCP server-scoped speed resolution
nodes.rationale: Auto chooses server comment, unit-marked server-name suffix, then configured manual rates; exact router/server keys; invalid selected source stops resolution.

nodes.label: Compiler ancestor-capacity admission
nodes.rationale: Compiler independently rejects aggregate minima beyond any ancestor so callers cannot bypass allocation.

nodes.label: Protected manual address-list overlap blocker
nodes.rationale: Historical final ledger states route findings resolved for explicit scope while manual overlap still blocked membership; no output generation or router change was made.

nodes.label: Narrow scoped forwarding policy
nodes.rationale: Recognize positive static ingress/subscriber lists and negated destination lists with earlier matching bypass; definitions and members required; composed or uncertain list evidence rejected.

nodes.label: Ancestor-aware proportional minimum allocation
nodes.rationale: After assignment and before compilation, reserve floors then proportionally scale remaining headroom per direction and ancestor; preserve router maxima and block floor exhaustion.

nodes.label: Transactional minimum adjustment
nodes.rationale: Use deterministic order and contiguous subtree ranges; commit inputs only after both directions pass; snapshot, CSV and validation candidate share effective minima.

nodes.label: Finite rates without guessed maxima
nodes.rationale: Invalid/unlimited explicit rates remain errors; profile names require a unit; burst fields validated but not translated into LibreQoS bursts.

nodes.label: Configured subscriber minimum fraction and floor
nodes.norm_label: configured subscriber minimum fraction and floor
nodes.rationale: Explicit router minima win; otherwise use configured fraction/floor capped by router maximum; preserve separate branch capacity policy.

nodes.label: Router-rate direction and unit conversion
nodes.rationale: Router receive/transmit maps to subscriber upload/download; bare fields use bits per second; comments use subscriber download/upload order.

nodes.label: Historical subscriber speed-source precedence
nodes.rationale: PPP: secret, active and profile comments then profile rate/name; Hotspot: user comment, profile comment/rate. This plan originally selected DHCP lease comment/rate; later DHCP-server plan supersedes that behavior.

nodes.label: Separate subscriber and router-reply paths
nodes.rationale: Actual WAN-ingress connection marks serve router replies in output, separate from subscriber direct list routing. Do not infer an actual subscriber-forward connection-mark chain.

nodes.label: Server-owned DHCP subscriber speed policy

nodes.label: Actual DHCP server rate inheritance
nodes.rationale: Bound leases inherit their actual server resolved rate. Lease comment/rate overrides no longer apply; invalid or missing server metadata cannot supply rates.

nodes.label: Per-server speed resolution index

nodes.label: DHCP server policy forms

nodes.label: Core Address-List Planner Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Atomic core-plan publication
nodes.rationale: Historical design stores core-plan.json beside the same snapshot and assignments before switching the immutable-generation pointer; declared corrupt/missing plans fail closed.

nodes.label: Conservative core policy checks
nodes.rationale: Requires fresh complete inventory, mapped core, positive unique list and custom table, terminal direct prerouting marks; unsupported constructs remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Exact-owned IPv4 host entries
nodes.rationale: Plan only individual IPv4 /32 entries with persistent application UUID and exact subscriber/WAN markers; preserve manual and other-owner rows.

nodes.label: Indexed subscriber/list planning
nodes.rationale: Avoid per-subscriber scans across all routes or address-list members; expensive work remains outside async workers and application locks.

nodes.label: Add/keep/remove preview
nodes.rationale: An IP or WAN move may yield both add and removal; rows do not encode safe execution order or a router transaction. A future writer must reread ownership and coordinate routing and shaping.

nodes.label: Atomic core-plan generation
nodes.rationale: Writes subscribers, assignments, CSV, JSON and core-plan.json durably before changing state/current.toml. All source/core inputs must remain at most five minutes old at commit; failures preserve the last valid generation.

nodes.label: Core address-list planner
nodes.rationale: Produces a local preview only; it neither writes routers nor creates routing tables or firewall rules.

nodes.label: Owned IPv4 /32 members
nodes.rationale: Exact lqosync3:APPLICATION_UUID:SUBSCRIBER_UUID:WAN_ID marker, current list, WAN, static enabled permanent host, unique identity and row ID must agree.

nodes.label: Protected manual and other-owner members
nodes.rationale: Overlapping hosts, CIDRs, or ranges block planning; unresolved DNS in configured lists blocks planning; retired lists are outside cleanup authority.

nodes.label: Conservative RouterOS 7 structural route audit
nodes.rationale: Requires one supported source-list routing consumer and one active resolved default on the mapped WAN per custom FIB table; unknown matchers, FastTrack, routing rules, PCC, jumps, and ambiguous defaults block planning. Does not prove traffic path.

nodes.label: WAN/core/list/custom-FIB binding
nodes.rationale: One binding per WAN; unique list names and custom tables per core; selected core must own the mapped WAN interface.

nodes.label: Bounded core findings and observed paths
nodes.norm_label: bounded core findings and observed paths
nodes.rationale: 256 findings and 512 observed paths produce explicit global overflow findings; display limits cannot silently convert incomplete evidence into Pass.

nodes.label: core-validate diagnostic command
nodes.rationale: Without --end-to-end zero means input review completed, not policy passed; local reports and saved fixtures do not publish output or refresh the web process.

nodes.label: Live/saved inventory health
nodes.rationale: Saved inventory remains historical and never enters active collection; live inventory can still be stale. Failed/partial required tables yield Unavailable.

nodes.label: Application-local TOML credentials
nodes.rationale: Exact stable router ID selects a private 0600 credentials.toml entry before environment fallback; empty/invalid local entries block authentication; parser errors omit source lines.

nodes.label: Observed-only custom-table paths
nodes.rationale: Without bindings, candidate paths do not create WAN roots or list bindings; mapping-required blocks a pass.

nodes.label: Read-only core review
nodes.rationale: Shares the planner route analyzer; GET never publishes a generation or changes assignments; structural Pass is not packet-routing proof or writer authorization.

nodes.label: Verified TLS and application-local CA
nodes.rationale: Checks certificate name and trust chain; custom public PEM and server name do not disable verification or install system trust.

nodes.label: Conditional candidate budget
nodes.rationale: 512 candidates including rejected candidates; explicit global overflow finding. UI caps 200 scopes and 32 ingress names with omitted counts.

nodes.label: Paired prerouting bypasses
nodes.rationale: Supported earlier accepts are paired positive destination list, OSPF/89, or UDP destination ports 3784,3785 without extra matchers; all active consumers must share the checked negative destination scope.

nodes.label: Scoped subscriber forwarding
nodes.rationale: Positive subscriber source list on explicit static ingress list; excludes local destinations and named IPv4 destination list; selects configured WAN table with passthrough=false.

nodes.label: Static destination exclusions
nodes.rationale: Enabled permanent IPv4 hosts/CIDRs/ranges only; unresolved DNS, unknown flags, full IPv4 coverage, or possible list writers block support.

nodes.label: Static ingress-list evidence
nodes.rationale: One static non-builtin list without include/exclude; unique enabled static members resolve to running enabled non-WAN interfaces. Definitions and members are both required.

nodes.label: Canonical artifact integrity
nodes.rationale: Snapshot, assignments and plan integrity precede artifact reads; CSV/JSON must equal canonical candidate output; each artifact at most 64 MiB; generation changes invalidate review.

nodes.label: Connection path budget
nodes.rationale: 512 paths per core with explicit global finding; UI displays first 200; mangle order is preserved and incomplete paths cannot silently Pass.

nodes.label: Read-only end-to-end validation
nodes.rationale: Compares captured router input with one immutable committed generation; GET never publishes, changes live inventory, writes routers, or applies shaping. Missing setup is Unavailable.

nodes.label: Live versus saved evidence
nodes.rationale: Only current-process complete consistent latest snapshots at most five minutes old support live review. Saved input stays historical even if recent and --saved --end-to-end returns nonzero.

nodes.label: Router-reply connection marks
nodes.rationale: WAN-ingress producer connects to output consumer using same WAN table. Reply paths do not satisfy subscriber-forward routing and cannot exclude local destinations with !local.

nodes.label: Subscriber-forward connection marks
nodes.rationale: One new/unmarked positive-source-list producer precedes one same-list/same-mark prerouting consumer selecting WAN table; producer continues, consumer requires passthrough=false.

nodes.label: Historical actual-core findings

nodes.label: Explicit WAN core-list bindings
nodes.rationale: Each WAN binds to its core/both router, unique address list and custom FIB table. Discovery does not determine intended bindings.

nodes.label: Final source and core freshness check
nodes.norm_label: final source and core freshness check
nodes.rationale: Recheck all source/core timestamps after writing artifacts and immediately before switching generation pointer to prevent source expiry during planning.

nodes.label: Five-file authoritative generation
nodes.rationale: Commit core-plan.json with snapshot, assignments and shaping pair before switching one pointer. Loader checks ownership, parents, IPs, scope and provenance; incomplete or corrupt declared state blocks.

nodes.label: Owned subscriber IPv4 host planning
nodes.rationale: Plan individual /32 hosts from the shaping snapshot and assignments. UUID ownership markers limit removals to enabled permanent static owned hosts in current configured lists.

nodes.label: Protected manual and other-owner entries
nodes.rationale: Manual overlaps, DNS ambiguity, malformed or duplicate ownership and dynamic owned rows block plans. Retired/unbound lists remain untouched.

nodes.label: Authoritative generation and mirror separation
nodes.rationale: Commit snapshot and CSV/JSON under one immutable pointer. Compatibility mirror failure remains visible without hiding committed data; corrupt committed snapshots error and clearing bindings cannot silently republish legacy data.

nodes.label: Bounded scheduled source collection
nodes.rationale: Selected routers read with at most four concurrent requests. Pause stops queued reads and future publication; epochs discard superseded results.

nodes.label: Exact source bindings and normalization
nodes.rationale: Bind PPP profiles, DHCP servers and Hotspot profiles to shaping nodes. Reject duplicate bindings, unknown mappings and identity/IP conflicts. Active DHCP fields override static lease fields.

nodes.label: Stable UUID v5 subscriber identity
nodes.rationale: IDs exclude IP, profile, hostname and node. DHCP uses canonical MAC; PPP/Hotspot use exact account identity scoped by router/service. Only same-router matching IP/MAC permits Hotspot to replace DHCP.

nodes.label: Committed assignment ownership
nodes.rationale: Commit assignments.toml with snapshot and output pair; validate active identity/parent consistency, block corrupt declared ownership and seed older generations from subscriber parents.

nodes.label: Directional planned-load balancing
nodes.rationale: Balance projected plan rates against directional WAN and explicit destination capacities. Same-kind targets are required; source remains collection binding while target becomes exported parent. This does not steer packets.

nodes.label: Sticky deterministic WAN assignment
nodes.rationale: Pins override previous assignments, which override balancing for new/unassigned clients. Inactive ownership survives nonempty scans/restarts/capacity changes without contributing load.

nodes.label: Explicit WAN interface mapping
nodes.rationale: Map one router/interface pair to one explicit WAN root with manual capacities. Fresh interface health gates publication; discovery alone does not prove path and failures do not trigger mass migration.

nodes.label: Connection-mark validation implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Subscriber Normalization and Source Selection
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Read-only end-to-end generation review
nodes.rationale: Reuses normalization, assignment, compilation and core planning; compares a candidate with one committed generation pointer; missing setup, stale inputs and changed artifacts remain blockers.

nodes.label: Router-reply connection-mark paths
nodes.rationale: Historical plan separates WAN ingress classifiers and output consumers from subscriber-forward routing evidence.

nodes.label: Structural validation limit
nodes.rationale: No packet-path simulation or production-readiness claim; PCC, FastTrack, jumps and unsupported conditions remain blocked.

nodes.label: Authoritative immutable generation pointer
nodes.rationale: Snapshot and CSV/JSON pair become visible through one pointer after all files exist; compatibility snapshot mirror is best effort.

nodes.rationale: Fresh healthy tables for selected routers are required; failed, partial or empty selected scans cannot cause deletion; epoch/settings changes invalidate publication.

nodes.label: Exact source-to-shaping-node binding
nodes.rationale: Bind one exact PPP profile, DHCP server or Hotspot profile per real node; reject duplicate bindings and unresolved selected users.

nodes.label: Exact Hotspot/DHCP overlap resolution
nodes.rationale: Hotspot supersedes DHCP only on the same router, IPv4 and canonical MAC; no guessed collision handling.

nodes.label: Stable UUID v5 subscriber identities
nodes.rationale: Identity uses router/service/account or canonical DHCP MAC, excluding IP, profile and node; multiple simultaneous IPs remain blocked.

nodes.label: Aliased routing projection
nodes.rationale: Fixture projection removes private values/comments and checks finding counts and path direction/status, but does not preserve address containment or all packet behavior.

nodes.label: Awaited bounded response sends
nodes.rationale: Original try_send cancelled normal bursts when the 16-event channel filled; awaiting reply and terminal events preserves rows and completion. Application consumes one command at a time and drops receiver on timeout. Do not retain unread receivers with concurrent commands on shared actor.

nodes.label: 200-row burst patch removal gate
nodes.rationale: Application regression sends 200 rows plus completion in one network write; remove patch only when selected upstream dependency passes it; RouterOS parser is not reimplemented.

nodes.rationale: Crates.io source, ferrohd/mikrotik-rs revision c64acc6455e90d491b410bb22523f82fd1f236f1; MIT OR Apache-2.0; upstream license and author metadata preserved.

nodes.label: MikrotikDevice background actor
nodes.rationale: Tokio drives sans-IO mikrotik_proto::Connection; cloned handles send DeviceCommand over mpsc, actor routes replies by tag to per-command receivers.

nodes.label: Drop-based command cancellation
nodes.rationale: Dropping command receiver sends /cancel; dropping all device handles shuts down connection.

nodes.label: mikrotik-rs high-level interface
nodes.rationale: Vendor recommends mikrotik-rs rather than direct mikrotik-tokio use.

nodes.rationale: Publication and Validation share effective minima; compiler independently checks ancestor budgets. Source-managed topology edits validate an allocated temporary copy.

nodes.rationale: New crate under v3 uses server-rendered Rust UI with Axum and Maud, application-local TOML settings/state and no database.

nodes.label: Project-local v3 knowledge index
nodes.rationale: Home links v3 session notes and handoff; current capabilities come from v3 README/design rather than earlier root application documentation.

nodes.label: Assignment priority and retention
nodes.rationale: Pin first, then valid previous assignment, then current default/balance mode. Clearing pin preserves eligible prior assignment. Inactive records persist but add no load; incompatible source changes with pins block publication.

nodes.label: Compatible source pools
nodes.rationale: Original source node remains; destinations share subscriber kind and cannot belong to other selected sources. Collection ownership stays at source; exported parent alone changes.

nodes.label: Explicit WAN interface mapping
nodes.rationale: Operator selects actual router interface; one router/interface pair maps to one WAN. Inventory must be fresh and mapped interface running and enabled; outage retains last generation and does not infer failover.

nodes.label: Generation assignment state
nodes.rationale: assignment.pools/pins live in settings; assignments.toml stores generation ownership. Active rows must match snapshot and target; missing/corrupt state blocks publication without silent reset.

nodes.label: Deterministic planned-load balancing
nodes.rationale: Sort new subscriber IDs and destination ties; minimize largest projected download/upload-to-WAN/destination-capacity ratio. Uses plan rates, not measured traffic, and is not admission control. Valid previous assignments never rebalance.

nodes.label: Actual Core Policy Validation Plan
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Bounded per-WAN findings
nodes.rationale: Each WAN receives scoped findings; global findings apply to all WANs; visible truncation cannot produce a pass.

nodes.label: Live and saved inventory provenance
nodes.rationale: Saved or incomplete inventory cannot authorize publication; last valid generations remain selected.

nodes.label: Application-local TOML credentials
nodes.rationale: Credentials remain in ignored v3/data/credentials.toml with mode 0600; no passwords in logs, rendering, or commits.

nodes.label: Shared indexed route analyzer
nodes.rationale: Design constraint: diagnostics and planning share conservative indexed route checks; unsupported policies cannot become passes.

nodes.label: RouterOS client and LibreQoS adapter selection
nodes.norm_label: routeros client and libreqos adapter selection
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Adapter production-readiness limit
nodes.rationale: Version selection does not establish deployment readiness; production export, authentication and applied-generation checks remain separate work.

nodes.label: Local LibreQoS control-family selection
nodes.rationale: Read installed main libreqos package with bounded query; older families choose legacy behavior, v3 chooses reload-request family; unknown states remain unsupported.

nodes.label: Pinned mikrotik-rs 0.7.0 dependency decision
nodes.rationale: Historical decision pins MIT/Apache-2.0 release with Tokio/TLS; later releases cited in this plan changed license. Pinning is not a claim of latest fixes.

nodes.label: Allowlisted verified-TLS RouterOS transport
nodes.rationale: Explicit print command/proplist allowlists, verified TLS and operation deadlines constrain inventory reads.

nodes.label: WAN Mapping and Subscriber Assignment
nodes.rationale: Historical design or implementation-plan document; reported checks are documentary evidence, not independently rerun verification.

nodes.label: Explicit discovered WAN interface mapping
nodes.rationale: Operator selects a fresh interface; one router/interface per WAN root; mapping does not prove actual subscriber packet paths.

nodes.label: No automatic WAN failover
nodes.rationale: Unavailable interfaces retain the last valid generation; planned distribution is not live traffic balancing or a hard admission quota.

nodes.label: Deterministic planned-load balancing
nodes.rationale: Directional plan-rate loads use configured WAN/target capacities, retained loads first, sorted subscriber IDs and target tie-breaks; rates remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Stable retained assignments and subscriber pins
nodes.norm_label: stable retained assignments and subscriber pins
nodes.rationale: Pins take precedence; optional balancing targets only new/unassigned subscribers; persist source ownership and target before pointer switch.

nodes.label: DHCP/Hotspot overlap ownership
nodes.rationale: Exact same-router IPv4 and MAC overlap belongs to Hotspot; DHCP is omitted and Hotspot rate/node is authoritative. Other duplicate IPs/IDs block publication.

nodes.label: Immutable local generation
nodes.rationale: Four files plus optional core-plan.json are durable before atomic state/current.toml selection. Corrupt committed snapshot is an error; state/subscribers.toml is a compatibility mirror, and mirror failure does not undo commit.

nodes.label: Selected-source publication health gates
nodes.rationale: Successful latest reads, complete required tables and at most five-minute inventory; empty scans, future timestamps, ambiguous metadata, unresolved rates and collisions preserve the last valid generation.

nodes.label: Scheduled bounded collection
nodes.rationale: At most four concurrent selected-source/mapped-WAN router reads; next interval begins after round ends; pause prevents queued reads and automatic publication; restart never trusts saved snapshots as active inventory.

nodes.label: Selected-source normalization
nodes.rationale: Exact PPP profile, DHCP server or Hotspot profile binds once to one subscriber shaping node. Unknown mappings block; valid unselected sources are skipped.

nodes.label: Single process per data directory
nodes.rationale: Generation retention and multi-process writer coordination remain unimplemented.

nodes.label: Stable subscriber UUID v5
nodes.rationale: PPP/Hotspot use router, service and exact account; DHCP uses router, service and canonical MAC. IP, hostname, profile, server and node are excluded. UUID is an identity key, not security.
